description: Compare the brand's keyword coverage against a competitor domain. Returns short detail by default: bucket totals only {overlapping: {total}, brandUnique: {total}, competitorOnly: {total}}. Use detail="medium" for capped keyword lists (up to 50 per bucket) or detail="full" for the raw API response.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: seo_competitor
